description: Enrich one person from their LinkedIn profile URL via Revternal — full normalized profile: name, headline, current company and title, past work experience, education, skills, certifications, and profile picture. Default (fetch_live: false) reads Revternal's existing record for that URL and returns found:false if there is none; set fetch_live: true to have Revternal fetch a fresh profile (slower, higher vendor cost). Use to enrich a lead, candidate, or contact you already have a LinkedIn URL for. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_enrich_person({ linkedin_url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishalv06" }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

fetch_live.description: false (default): return Revternal's existing profile record, found:false if none (1 credit if found). true: Revternal fetches fresh profile data (5 credits, slower, higher vendor cost).

linkedin_url.description: Personal LinkedIn profile URL containing /in/, e.g. "https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishalv06". A bare username is also accepted.

name: revternal_enrich_person
title: Revternal Enrich Person
